card.text: M28 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 5,370 parsecs away.

sources.label: Baumgardt & Vasiliev (2021), Accurate distances to Galactic globular clusters through a combination of Gaia EDR3, HST and literature data, MNRAS 505, 5957; Baumgardt's orbits table, NGC_6626: Rsun 5.37 ± 0.1 kpc
Wikipedia, "Messier 28"
sources.quote: Messier 28 or M28, also known as NGC 6626, is a globular cluster of stars in the center-west of Sagittarius.

introduction.text: M28 is drawn as 857 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
